gemm_arithmetic_decision.purpose: Deterministic GEMM arithmetic for interpreter and later RTL; no HDL implementation authorization.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.lane_order: K increasing; each output column has an independent reduction.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.product: FP32 multiplication, round-to-nearest ties-to-even; no fused multiply-add.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.K16_reduction: Adjacent balanced binary tree: 16 products -> 8 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1; every addition rounds to FP32 with ties-to-even.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.W4_group: Eight K16 tree results accumulated in increasing K order into FP32 group sum initialized to +0; then multiply by stored FP32 group scale with FP32 rounding.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.W4_output: Accumulate scaled group results in increasing group order into FP32 output partial sum initialized to +0; preserve across residency tiles and normal command chunks.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.BF16_attention: Accumulate K16 tree results in increasing K order in FP32, without group scaling.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.tail: Absent K lanes contribute +0 and perform no operand read.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.output_rounding: Previously agreed: bias in FP32 before final BF16 nearest-even for QKV; completed unbiased output casts only after full reduction.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.FP32_exceptions_subnormals: Pending separate specification and implementation feasibility review.
gemm_arithmetic_decision.acceptance: Interpreter and RTL must match this arithmetic contract; original BF16 reference and W4 model quality are separate comparisons, with tolerances still pending.

nonlinear_rounding_decision.source: modeling_qwen2.py, pinned Transformers 4.46.3 eager BF16 reference
nonlinear_rounding_decision.rounding: BF16 conversions round to nearest ties to even; no arithmetic fusion across listed rounding boundaries.
nonlinear_rounding_decision.RMSNorm: BF16 input -> FP32 square, mean, epsilon addition, rsqrt and normalization -> BF16 intermediate -> multiply BF16 gamma -> BF16 output. Reduction order and rsqrt implementation pending.
nonlinear_rounding_decision.RoPE: BF16 Q/K and BF16 cos/sin table; each of two products rounds to BF16, then their sum rounds to BF16. rotate_half uses [-second_half, first_half], with head dimension 64.
nonlinear_rounding_decision.SOFTMAX_MASKED: FP32 QK scratch -> BF16 score -> scale by 1/8 -> BF16 scaled score -> causal mask -> FP32 stable softmax -> BF16 probabilities. Mask construction, reduction order, exp and reciprocal implementation pending.
nonlinear_rounding_decision.SILU_MUL: BF16 gate -> SiLU -> BF16 intermediate -> multiply BF16 up -> BF16 output. SiLU approximation pending.
nonlinear_rounding_decision.limitations: Specifies dtype boundaries only; no nonlinear approximation, exceptional/subnormal policy or numerical quality tolerance is frozen. No ISA/interpreter/RTL evidence.

bank_packing_readiness_decision.endianness: little-endian; earliest element occupies lowest bits/bytes
bank_packing_readiness_decision.BF16_FP32_rows: Row-major; each row begins on a 16-byte boundary; logical dimensions and physical row stride are separate descriptor fields.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.padding: Padding elements are zero initialized and never included in mathematical reductions. BF16 row stride rounds up to 8 elements; FP32 row stride rounds up to 4 elements.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.W4_projection: Output-major rows, K increasing; 128 K codes per row=64 bytes; first code in low nibble, second in high nibble; signed two-complement nibble; -8 rejected.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.projection_scales: One FP32 scale per output for the resident K128 group, output order matching weight rows.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.embedding_scales: 7 FP32 scales per hidden896 row, padded to 8 entries=32 bytes; padding is not a scale. Up to16 rows=512 bytes.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.attention_score_probability: Physical row width1024 elements for SCORE/PROB; actual context L defines valid columns; padded columns are excluded from softmax/GEMM.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.partial_assembly: Descriptor tracks tensor identity/shape/layout and covered semantic tiles. New outputs are invalid until successful completion; assembly destinations become valid only after all required tiles complete.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.partial_sum: GEMM INIT starts from +0; ACCUM requires matching valid FP32 partial sum with expected next K group. Final tensor availability is distinct from valid partial-sum availability.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.failed_commands: Invalidate any destination affected by a failed write; preserve source liveness; do not advance assembly coverage or expected K. No rollback of physical partial writes is assumed.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.chunk_END: Preserve descriptors, coverage and partial sums on normal END/DONE.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.ownership: Unchanged atomic exclusive bank acquisition, release by matching completion; legal partial assembly never bypasses ownership.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.offset_rule: Compute commands use logical bank handles; LAYOUT may specify semantic row/column/head selection, not a raw byte offset. DMA addresses remain explicit.
bank_packing_readiness_decision.limitations: Exact command bit fields, per-layout capability matrix and the full workload schedule remain pending. No HDL implemented.

SCORE_FFN_scratch_decision.FFN_layout: FP32 [M<=16,128] projection scratch for gate or up
SCORE_FFN_scratch_decision.schedule: Gate projection completes and CAST writes GATE_TILE before SCORE is reinitialized for up. Up CAST writes UP_TILE before reuse. Seven down PSUM banks remain resident.
SCORE_FFN_scratch_decision.exclusion: Attention score and FFN scratch lifetimes must not overlap.
SCORE_FFN_scratch_decision.descriptor_rule: Reinitialize logical tensor identity/layout/coverage under exclusive ownership. No old score validity carried into FFN scratch.
SCORE_FFN_scratch_decision.fabric_role: GEMM_PSUM; source for vector CAST, in addition to masked-softmax score source
